Northeast Indian diaspora showcases traditions in London

Individuals from India's Northeast region living in the UK organized an event in London to display their ancestral traditions. The festival aimed to present the Northeast region to a global audience and highlight its cultural diversity. This event served as a platform for the diaspora to connect with their heritage and share it internationally.
